semiconductor_relevance: High — Green Optics specializes in advanced optical inspection systems for semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on thin-film analysis and defect detection.
summary: Green Optics Co., Ltd. is a total optical solutions provider that offers advanced inspection systems for the semiconductor industry. Their technologies enable non-contact, non-destructive analysis of thin films, residual films, and surface variations, enhancing quality control in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Non-contact optical inspection systems for thin-film thickness and uniformity
Residual layer inspection systems for detecting organic films and micro-scale defects
